title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in IoPt, implemented by partners Adalah, B'Tselem, PCHR, CFTA, EAPPI and YWCA, supports civil society to demand accountability, equal rights and justice and to support Palestinian communities to have their rights met. Implemented in the Gaza Strip, the West Bank and in Israel, the objectives of the grant are to support marginalised Palestinian communities to claim their rights, with a particular focus on women and marginalised groups, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. Target communities include Palestinian women, youth, children, men and community groups in Gaza and the West Bank, Bedouin communities in the Naqab/Negev and Palestinian citizens of Israel.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: PSE . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Programme objectives are not thematic. The overall progamme aims to promote more effective and accountable institutions that support equal rights and justice, in particular for Palestinian individuals and communities. Work that contributes to specific SDG targets will span all objectives through complementary approaches and actions.
